title.narrative: Sixth Water (Vieux Fort Water Supply Redevelopment) Project

description.narrative: The revised project consists of the following components: (a) Land (b) Infrastructure Works (i) Water production facilities comprising: two river intake structures; two treatment plants; and four new pumping stations (ii) 15.7 kilometres (km) of new high-density polyethylene (HDPE) transmission mains (iii) six new storage reservoirs totalling 5,675 cubic metres (m3) (c) Vieux Fort Non-Revenue Water (NRW) Reduction Programme (d) Capacity building of WASCO comprising (i) Technical Assistance (TA) to conduct an energy audit of WASCO facilities (ii) TA to conduct a water audit for the Vieux Fort Water Supply System (e) TA for the preparation of the Vieux Fort Watershed Management Plan (f) Vieux Fort River Watershed Protection and Management (g) WASCO Operational and Energy Efficiency Improvement Programme (h) Project Management and Monitoring including Gender Impact Evaluation (i) Engineering Services
